summary: Nice slides a flat dominant hand across the palm of the other hand, like smoothing a surface. It's also the first half of 'nice to meet you.'
movement: Dominant palm slides across the non-dominant palm
steps: Hold your non-dominant hand flat, palm up.
Place your dominant hand flat, palm down, on top near your wrist.
Slide it smoothly out toward the fingertips.
note: NICE and CLEAN are the same sign. Context decides which one you mean.
mistakes: Sliding back and forth. It's one smooth slide outward.
